note: 工具发现 baseline 语料：102 条真实能力（name/description 取自主代理目录声明），category 由 ToolRegistry 按名前缀派生。queries 的 relevant 注记即语义真值；词面可及性依赖真实别名规则（4 字窗口命中 4 字别名 / latin token 命中名前缀）。tuning/frozen 各 6 条。

tools.name: file_list
tools.description: List files and folders under the user-authorized /workspace directory.

tools.name: file_read
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file from /workspace. Common locations: notes/, reports/, ppt/, scripts/, data/.

tools.name: file_write
tools.description: Write UTF-8 text to a file in /workspace. Creates parent folders.

tools.name: file_edit
tools.description: Edit a text file in /workspace by replacing exact old_text with new_text.

tools.name: file_search
tools.description: Search UTF-8 text files in /workspace for a query string.

tools.name: file_move
tools.description: Move or rename a file/folder inside /workspace.

tools.name: pdf_read
tools.description: Extract text from a PDF file in /workspace using the bundled MuPDF parser.

tools.name: ocr_image
tools.description: OCR a /workspace image. Stage 1 reports runtime availability; use a VLM model if OCR runtime is unavailable.

tools.name: terminal_execute
tools.description: Run a one-shot command in Alpine or over SSH. For SSH pass runtime=remote_ssh and ssh_profile_id.

tools.name: terminal_ssh_profiles
tools.description: List saved SSH profiles, their IDs, default selection and host-key trust readiness. Returns no credentials.

tools.name: terminal_job_start
tools.description: Start a terminal command as a background job, locally or over SSH.

tools.name: terminal_job_read
tools.description: Read current status and output tail from a terminal job.

tools.name: terminal_job_wait
tools.description: Wait for a terminal job to finish, or return its current status after the wait timeout.

tools.name: terminal_job_stop
tools.description: Stop a running terminal job.

tools.name: terminal_session_start
tools.description: Start a persistent Alpine/proot terminal session in the AmberAgent runtime workspace.

tools.name: terminal_session_exec
tools.description: Send a command to a persistent terminal session.

tools.name: search_web
tools.description: Search the web through AmberAgent Search Orchestrator. It uses enabled API services first, then built-in public/vertical sources.

tools.name: scrape_web
tools.description: Scrape a URL for detailed page content. Built-in Jina Reader is available without an API key.

tools.name: http_request
tools.description: Make a bounded HTTP/HTTPS request. Does not send app cookies or private device data.

tools.name: webview_open
tools.description: Open a URL in AmberAgent's live operation preview WebView.

tools.name: webview_read
tools.description: Read the currently opened AmberAgent WebView page: title and readable visible text.

tools.name: wm_open
tools.description: Open a URL in a pooled headless WebView. Re-uses an existing session if session_id is provided and still alive.

tools.name: wm_observe
tools.description: Efficient all-in-one WebMount page observation. Returns semantic page state, readable text, visible interactive nodes.

tools.name: wm_run_goal
tools.description: Run a bounded autonomous loop toward one web goal on an existing WebMount session. Each step observes the live snapshot.

tools.name: wm_click
tools.description: Click an element in a WebMount session. Prefer target with a ref returned by wm_extract.

tools.name: wm_type
tools.description: Type text into an editable element (input/textarea/contenteditable) in a WebMount session.

tools.name: wm_scroll
tools.description: Scroll a WebMount session by target, selector or viewport.

tools.name: wm_screenshot
tools.description: Capture the current page of a WebMount session and return its base64-encoded image.

tools.name: wm_visual_read
tools.description: Read a small visual region from a WebMount page using the configured vision recognition model.

tools.name: wm_network_inspect
tools.description: Inspect redacted XHR/fetch request templates observed in a WebMount session.

tools.name: wm_fetch_replay
tools.description: Replay an observed same-origin GET/HEAD request template from inside the page context.

tools.name: wm_eval
tools.description: HIGH RISK. Evaluate arbitrary JavaScript in the WebMount session and return the result.

tools.name: wm_site_remove
tools.description: Remove a website from the user's WebMount Stations list. Also clears the site's cookies, OAuth credentials and tokens.

tools.name: feishu_docs_search
tools.description: Search the user's 飞书 docs by keyword. Returns up to limit matching documents.

tools.name: feishu_docs_read
tools.description: Read a 飞书 docx document as Markdown text. Prefer doc_ref; url and document_id are also accepted.

tools.name: feishu_docs_list
tools.description: List 飞书 cloud-drive files. With folder_token omitted, lists the OAuth user's root drive.

tools.name: feishu_docs_create
tools.description: Create a new empty 飞书 docx document with the given title.

tools.name: github_repo_search
tools.description: Search public GitHub repositories. q accepts the GitHub search syntax.

tools.name: github_repo_read
tools.description: Get full metadata about one GitHub repo: stars, forks, language, default branch, topics.

tools.name: github_file_read
tools.description: Read a single text file from a GitHub repo. path is the file path within the repo.

tools.name: bilibili_search
tools.description: Search B站 videos by keyword. Returns up to limit videos on page. Anonymous-friendly.

tools.name: bilibili_hot_videos
tools.description: B站热门视频 (web-interface/popular). Anonymous-friendly; cookies improve geo-availability.

tools.name: zhihu_search
tools.description: Search 知乎 (general type — mixes questions, answers, articles, users).

tools.name: hn_top
tools.description: Read a HackerNews story feed. feed defaults to top; also accepts new / best / ask / show / job.

tools.name: hn_search
tools.description: Full-text search HackerNews via Algolia. tags is the Algolia tag filter.

tools.name: screen_run_goal
tools.description: Use Jev to accelerate Android Accessibility: open the specified app, then execute a bounded goal internally with fresh UI-node validation.

tools.name: screen_click
tools.description: Tap screen coordinates using AmberAgent Accessibility after user approval.

tools.name: screen_read_ui
tools.description: Read the current Accessibility UI tree for screen reasoning.

tools.name: screen_screenshot
tools.description: Capture one screen frame for VLM reasoning using Android MediaProjection after user approval.

tools.name: screen_open_app
tools.description: Open an installed Android app by package name.

tools.name: screen_input_text
tools.description: Set text on the currently focused editable field using Accessibility.

tools.name: vlm_task
tools.description: Plan a phone automation task with VLM-style trace semantics.

tools.name: sms_send
tools.description: Send an SMS from this device. Requires SEND_SMS and explicit approval.

tools.name: contacts_search
tools.description: Search Android contacts by name, phone, or email after READ_CONTACTS is granted.

tools.name: battery_status
tools.description: Read device battery level, charging state, and power-save mode.

tools.name: network_status
tools.description: Read coarse connectivity status, transport type, and VPN/roaming hints.

tools.name: device_info
tools.description: Read device brand, model, Android version, ABI, and screen metrics.

tools.name: share_text
tools.description: Open Android share sheet with plain text. Requires approval because it sends data outside AmberAgent.

tools.name: memory_list
tools.description: List AmberAgent memory entries by type: core, short_term, long_term, or all.

tools.name: memory_write
tools.description: Create a new AmberAgent memory entry. Core and long-term memory should be stable and important.

tools.name: conversation_context_status
tools.description: Inspect current conversation context pressure, compact summaries, and next automatic compression action.

tools.name: conversation_search
tools.description: Search this conversation's original transcript and compact summaries.

tools.name: conversation_expand
tools.description: Expand a compact summary id or source message id back to original transcript snippets.

tools.name: session_search
tools.description: Search snippets across historical sessions. Returns short excerpts, not full transcripts.

tools.name: agent_task_list
tools.description: List AmberAgent background tasks in this Android app, including terminal jobs, subagents, model council runs.

tools.name: agent_runtime_status
tools.description: Read a concise AmberAgent harness runtime status summary, including task counts by status and type.

tools.name: cron_task_list
tools.description: List AmberAgent mobile cron tasks scheduled on this Android device.

tools.name: cron_task_create
tools.description: Create a mobile-side cron task. The task will trigger AmberAgent on this Android device.

tools.name: subagent_start
tools.description: Start a built-in or dynamic subagent as an isolated task.

tools.name: subagent_list
tools.description: List built-in and user-defined subagents with routing rules.

tools.name: subagent_read
tools.description: Read subagent run status and compact structured result by run_id.

tools.name: subagent_wait
tools.description: Wait for a subagent run to complete, up to wait_timeout_ms.

tools.name: subagent_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a running subagent task by run_id.

tools.name: subagent_followup
tools.description: Continue an idle (not running) subagent thread with a new task.

tools.name: subagent_send_message
tools.description: Deliver a message to a subagent thread.

tools.name: subagent_report
tools.description: Record the structured result for the supervisor.

tools.name: model_council_status
tools.description: Show Model Council experimental mode status, configured seats, limits, role presets.

tools.name: model_council_start
tools.description: Start a Model Council run. Use mode=compare for one-shot independent answers.

tools.name: model_council_read
tools.description: Read a Model Council run status, turns, result, and transcript path by run_id.

tools.name: model_council_wait
tools.description: Wait for a Model Council run to finish.

tools.name: model_council_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a running Model Council run by run_id.

tools.name: model_council_make_report
tools.description: Write a Model Council result as Markdown under /workspace/model-council. Requires approval.

tools.name: mcp_list
tools.description: List configured MCP servers, enabled state, connection status, and known tool counts.

tools.name: mcp_call_tool
tools.description: Call one tool exposed by a configured MCP server.

tools.name: skills_list
tools.description: List AmberAgent skills and their load status.

tools.name: use_skill
tools.description: Load and apply a skill to get specialized instructions or capabilities.

tools.name: tool_search
tools.description: Search AmberAgent's full tool catalog by intent/category and expose the best matching tool schemas.

tools.name: tools_list
tools.description: Debug/catalog view of AmberAgent's full tool catalog.

tools.name: tool_policy_explain
tools.description: Explain how AmberAgent would evaluate one tool invocation without executing it.

tools.name: jev_status
tools.description: Report AmberAgent's Jev quick-judgment service status: master switch, API mode and resolved endpoint.

tools.name: ask_user
tools.description: Ask the user one or more questions when you need clarification, additional information, or confirmation.

tools.name: permissions_status
tools.description: List AmberAgent Android permission capability status and how to grant missing permissions.

tools.name: get_time_info
tools.description: Get the current local date and time info from the device.

tools.name: clipboard_tool
tools.description: Read or write plain text from the device clipboard. Use action: read or write.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate photographic, painted, illustrated, or otherwise textured raster imagery from a text prompt.

tools.name: provider_config_status
tools.description: Read-only inventory of configured AI providers, their enabled/model/auth state, and the six default model slots.

tools.name: provider_config_apply
tools.description: Atomically update ONE provider: enable/disable, set or clear the API key, change the base URL.

tools.name: provider_refresh_models
tools.description: Fetch the model catalog for ONE provider through the provider's own API and write it back.

tools.name: settings_set_model_slot
tools.description: Set one default model slot: chat, title, ocr, compress, suggestion, or image_generation.

tools.name: js_cell_run
tools.description: Execute JavaScript code in a persistent cell (ES2020, QuickJS).

tools.name: reminder_create
tools.description: 创建一个本机提醒并立即写入持久存储及 Android 闹钟。

tools.name: reminder_list
tools.description: 列出 AmberAgent 在本机保存的提醒及其下次触发时间。

queries.text: 帮我屏幕截图看一下当前页面
用终端运行命令查看进程列表
帮我搜索文件里的 roadmap 关键词
打开网页搜索今天的新闻头条
用飞书云文档找会议纪要
用 github 搜 star 最多的仓库
bilibili_search 查最近的马拉松训练视频
开个模型会议分析这个架构决策
启动 subagent 帮我做竞品调研
查一下 jev 判断服务的运行状态
读取网页全文做成摘要
